**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the Integration readback's release authority**

When `scripts/vlm/issue_1719_integration_techniques_readback.mjs --check` queries its fixed `qrow_9709_m16_qp_12_q02::q02` fixture, this new overlay-instance branch makes the response identify the P1 manifest, but that script still records `KG_V0_SEMANTIC_RELEASE_AUTHORITY` (the P3 authority) as `release_authority`. Its check currently passes because it never compares those values, so the resulting authenticated evidence contains contradictory release receipts; update the consumer to use/validate the P1 authority when this surface is selected.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Fixed in 2c4c71434b25e20778d289c3ec187177168dc005. The readback script now selects authority from response.kg_release.active_paper_scope, validates the returned manifest path/hash and starting authority against that selected surface, and records the validated P1 authority. Added a regression that rejects a P1 response carrying stale P3 authority bytes; `node --test scripts/vlm/__tests__/issue_1719_integration_techniques_readback.test.mjs` passes 2/2 and the real `--check` passes.
